description: A proposed movement outside the admissible region where a claimed redirect does not reduce admissibility distance. The movement must resolve to REFUSE and remain non-binding.

expected_kernel_resolution.reason: Movement is outside admissible region with no lawful correction path.

field_law: Redirect is lawful only if delta(M_redirected) < delta(M_original). If redirect does not reduce admissibility distance, it is not repair; it is laundering.
